findings.description: The bowl was established with 3 red, 3 green, 3 yellow balls (2R/3G/3Y at 00:00 plus one red returned at 00:02.5) and nothing is added or removed during stirring, yet at 00:07.75 at least 5 distinct red balls are visible, and at 00:09.25 four red and four green balls are visible with no yellow; colour counts exceed what was present, so balls are changing colour/kind or duplicating while being stirred.

Smooth rigid spherical balls seen clearly at 00:00-00:04.75 become lumpy, irregular, faceted blobs (pepper/berry-like) from about 00:06 through 00:09.75 while only being stirred, beyond what motion blur explains (e.g. frames 00:09.25, 00:09.75 show angular shapes with sharp edges).

At 00:00 the bowl holds 2 red balls and the hands appear empty; by 00:00.75 a red ball is in the hands while the bowl still visibly contains both original red balls and all 8 original balls. The 9th red ball's origin is not shown (it may have been concealed in the blurred hand entering frame), so this is a weak custody gap.
